ScriptCancelled.doc: Raised in the running script when the user presses Stop (D2).

check_cancel.doc: Raise ScriptCancelled if Stop was requested for this run (game thread); else return whether it was.

clear_output.doc: Clear the Dream output view. GT only; works during a run.

new_tab.doc: Create a scratch tab. Returns the tab ID. GT only.

open.doc: Open or focus a file in a Dream tab and place the caret. Returns the tab ID. GT only.

progress.doc: Report i of n items done (U12); n None is an indeterminate bar. Any thread; a no-op outside a run.

run.doc: Queue a run of a tab (ID or name) or a file; return its number. RuntimeError inside a run. GT only.

sleep.doc: Sleep in slices of at most 50 ms; raise ScriptCancelled on Stop (D2). Any thread.

suppress.doc: Hide or show output kinds, like Maya's scriptEditorInfo -suppress* flags.
